This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org/) proposal so agents can discover clean markdown versions of site content. Prefer these files over scraping HTML.

- Marketing site for XON MEDIA LTD (not a product app or dashboard)
- Primary pages: homepage (anchored sections) and Contact

- Brand fonts and logo: `brand/fonts/`, `brand/logo/`
